_meta.name: gcp-oauth-setup
_meta.description: Set up Google OAuth 2.0 Desktop Client ID for the SOMA stack. Phases: (1) select/create soma-stack project, (2) configure OAuth consent screen (Internal, SOMA Stack app), (3) enable six required APIs, (4) create Desktop app OAuth client named SOMA Desktop Client, (5) trigger JSON download. Idempotent: detects existing consent screen and credential before creating.
anomalies: GCP Console is an Angular SPA — each page navigation needs 3-5s delay to fully render
Project picker opens as an overlay modal; URL does not change when it opens
After selecting a project the URL gains ?project=PROJECT_ID — subsequent navigations use GCP's session state (cookie) so explicit project param is not required
OAuth consent screen URL: new path is /auth/consent, older path is /apis/credentials/consent — both redirect correctly
API ENABLE button text may be 'Enable' or 'ENABLE' depending on UI version — using click_text which is case-insensitive
If an API is already enabled the page shows a 'Manage' button instead; click_text 'Enable' will log a not-found error but the chain can continue
Scope picker: 'Add or Remove Scopes' opens a dialog with a 'Manually add scopes' textarea at the bottom — paste all URIs newline-separated then click 'Add to Table', then 'Update'
Credential download saves to ~/Downloads/ as client_secret_<CLIENTID>.apps.googleusercontent.com.json — must be mv'd to target path after skill runs
After clicking CREATE for the OAuth client ID, a dialog shows the client ID/secret and a DOWNLOAD JSON button — that dialog is step s94
GCP may show a 'Getting started' wizard on first project visit — click 'DISMISS' or navigate away
_meta.prerequisite: Chrome session logged in as mw@mike-wolf.com with access to a Google Workspace org (mike-wolf.com)

project-picker-btn.description: Project picker button in GCP Console header — shows current project name or 'Select a project'
project-picker-btn.resolveHint: Look for a button in the top navigation bar containing a project name or dropdown caret. In recent GCP UI, class includes 'cfc-switch-button' or the aria-label contains 'Select a project'. Text content is the current project name.

project-picker-search.description: Search input in the project picker modal dialog
project-picker-search.resolveHint: After the project picker overlay opens, a search box appears near the top of the dialog. aria-label is typically 'Search projects and folders'.

new-project-name.description: Project name input on the Create Project page
new-project-name.resolveHint: Form at console.cloud.google.com/projectcreate. The first text input is the project name.

consent-internal-radio.description: Internal radio button on OAuth consent screen user type selection
consent-internal-radio.resolveHint: The consent screen user type page has two radio buttons: Internal and External. 'Internal' limits access to the Workspace org.

consent-app-name.description: App name text input in OAuth consent screen form
consent-app-name.resolveHint: First required field in the OAuth consent screen app information form.

consent-support-email.description: User support email dropdown in consent screen form
consent-support-email.resolveHint: A dropdown (not text input) populated with emails from the Workspace org.

consent-developer-email.description: Developer contact email input in consent screen form
consent-developer-email.resolveHint: Last email field in the consent form. May be a chip-input where you type an email and press Enter.

scope-manual-textarea.description: Manually add scopes textarea in the scope picker dialog
scope-manual-textarea.resolveHint: Bottom section of the scope picker dialog labeled 'Manually add scopes'. A multiline textarea that accepts scope URIs one per line.

oauth-app-type-select.description: Application type dropdown on OAuth client ID creation form
oauth-app-type-select.resolveHint: First field on the OAuth client ID creation form. Dropdown with options including 'Web application', 'Desktop app', 'Android', etc.

oauth-client-name.description: Name input field on OAuth client ID creation form
oauth-client-name.resolveHint: Second field on the OAuth client creation form. Pre-populated with 'Desktop client N'. Clear and type 'SOMA Desktop Client'.

landing.description: GCP Console landing page, project may or may not be selected

project-picker-open.description: Project picker overlay is open with search box

project-selected.description: A project is active, header shows project name, URL has ?project= param

consent-screen.description: OAuth consent screen page for current project

credentials-page.description: Credentials dashboard showing OAuth client IDs

credential-dialog.description: Post-creation dialog showing client ID/secret with DOWNLOAD JSON button
